name: Defender for Cloud / Exempted and policy-disabled recommendations
text:
// Adapted from 'ASC exempt and disabled recommendations' by Microsoft (https://github.com/Azure/Microsoft-Defender-for-Cloud/tree/main/Kusto/Azure%20Resource%20Graph/ASC%20exempt%20and%20disabled%20recommendations), MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
SecurityResources
| where type == 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| extend Cause = tostring(properties.status.cause)
| where Cause in ('Exempt', 'OffByPolicy')
| project Recommendation = tostring(properties.displayName), Severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity), Cause, Description = tostring(properties.status.description), Resource = tolower(extract('^(.+)/providers/Microsoft.Security/assessments/.+$', 1, id)), Source = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Source), subscriptionId, resourceGroup
| order by Severity asc, Recommendation asc
